rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a medical doctor specializing in psychiatry.

example.english: I want to see a psychiatrist because I haven't been sleeping well lately.
example.traditional: 我想搵精神科醫生睇下，最近成日瞓唔着。
